notes: A MAINTENANCE RELEASE — NOTHING CHANGES IN HOW YOU WORK. There is no new feature here and nothing you do day to day behaves differently. If 0.6.77 is serving you well there is no urgency; install it when it suits you. THE APP CAN NO LONGER OPEN TO A BLANK SCREEN. macOS sometimes asks for your keychain password when an app starts — most often just after you have installed a new version, because the installer is signed afresh each time. Until now that question could arrive BEFORE the app had drawn its window, so there was nothing on screen to explain what was being asked and, if the question went unanswered, the app simply sat there having opened your books and shown you nothing. The window is now created first, so anything the system asks arrives over a window you can see, and the app carries on the moment you answer. This was found on our own machine and it is the one substantive change in this release. CLOSE VIA JOURNAL IS NOW TESTED AUTOMATICALLY. The action that put the brought-forward cheque to rest in August is now exercised end to end before every release: a voucher code that does not exist is refused by name, a journal whose amount does not match is refused with both figures shown, and the cheque and the lodgement are both proven to change the register WITHOUT posting anything to the ledger. It has worked correctly since the day it was written; it now has to keep proving it. AND THE UPDATE NOTICE ITSELF IS CHECKED before it is published, so a release can no longer be advertised to you with a missing publication date. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your data and settings are untouched and you install straight over the old version. Back up first as a habit — Backup & Export, Back up now.
